[TRANSCRIPT]: Emergency services are receiving reports of a total blackout across the financial district. Traffic lights are synced to green in all directions. Possible synchronized cyber attack on the municipal grid.

[ALERT]: Local hospital ransomware attack. All patient monitors have gone dark. Emergency surgeries being performed by flashlight. Source IP traced to offshore botnet.

911 Operator: What is the nature of the emergency? Caller: I'm at the scrap yard. We just punctured a lead container with a 'Radioactive' symbol. Everyone's skin is itching and the Geiger counters are screaming.
